props.name: args
props.description: Arguments the tool was called with – objects are pretty-printed, JSON strings parsed

props.name: duration
props.description: Final duration in ms – otherwise measured while the card shows "running"

props.name: error
props.description: Error message, shown when status is "error"

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon in the tile on the left – defaults to a wrench

props.name: maxCodeHeight
props.description: Height in px after which arguments and result are capped with a fade and "Show all"

props.name: name
props.description: Tool name as the agent calls it, shown in mono – e.g. "search_web"

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows a Retry button next to the error

props.name: openOnError
props.description: Opens the card when the call fails and closes it again on the next run, unless someone toggled it

props.name: result
props.description: What the tool returned – objects are pretty-printed, JSON strings parsed, other text shown as is

props.name: startedAt
props.description: When the call started (ms since epoch, e.g. Date.now()) – the live timer counts from here

props.name: summary
props.description: Short human summary – e.g. "Searched the web for 'CRM pricing 2026'"
